status: The original half-denominator/S_lambda estimates are proved. The subsequent actual full native half-map, phase inverse and native pencil/resolvent factorization are now proved in hill-normalized-resolvent-map.json. Periodic contour convergence and full C.4 remain OPEN.
results: For EVERY 0<=r<=1 the full weighted reciprocal supremum on the ENTIRE literal original source circle is at most 16*n^(2*r-1). Both resonant modes and ALL far signed modes are retained. The far denominator controls the squared signed index; no finite-mode or reduced-symbol approximation is substituted.

The exact squared Sobolev weight of a frequency difference is bounded by FOUR times the sum of the two individual squared weights. This gives a genuine summable full double-reciprocal row and a bound UNIFORM in EVERY original potential-frequency difference: 128*(8*exp(1)+2)*log(n)*n^(2*r-2).

A reusable actual l2 operator is CONSTRUCTED from every complex matrix with summable squared entries. Every row acts by its absolutely convergent unconjugated complex product sum, on EVERY l2 input. The operator norm squared is bounded by the FULL squared-entry sum; no pre-existing bounded operator is assumed.

The ACTUAL source matrix S_lambda(l,m)=q_(l-m)/(sqrt(|lambda-pi^2*l^2|)*sqrt(|lambda-pi^2*m^2|)) is CONSTRUCTED with the original raw potential coefficients. Summability of ALL squared entries is PROVED from the weighted full-row estimate and the exact original H^(-r) norm, using a bijective integer frequency shear without any lost row, column, signed mode or resonance.

The ACTUAL normalized perturbation is a GENUINE bounded operator on the ENTIRE l2 space, with a proof-independent total parameter family recovering every original matrix entry on the source circles. Its norm squared is at most 128*(8*exp(1)+2)*log(n)*n^(2*r-2)*norm(q)_H^-r^2. No matrix-summability or bounded-operator property is supplied as a hypothesis of this source estimate.

The SAME ACTUAL matrix is realized on ALL source-normalized physical periodic L2 inputs, with EXACTLY the SAME coefficient operator norm. Its physical Fourier output is the literal full original source row sum. Both original half-denominator factors and every original raw potential/input frequency are retained.

For EVERY 0<=r<1 and EVERY specified original H^(-r) norm bound R, ONE cutoff BEFORE EVERY original complex potential in that ball, ALL later ORIGINAL positive indices and ALL points on each literal source circle makes the ACTUAL physical L2 norm of S_lambda at most ONE HALF. This includes the entire original Appendix C.4 range -1<t<-1/2, with r=-t.

The article adapter uses the ENTIRE ORIGINAL FourierLebesgueSpace(2,-r,2) distribution and EXACT ORIGINAL Sobolev norm. No coefficient-only replacement, physical period rescaling, source-index shift, reality premise or mean-zero restriction is added. The original physically period-one complex mean-zero source is included. The actual normalized-potential operator and its smallness are PROVED; identification of the perturbed inverse with the native resolvent remains OPEN.
